facts.note: The region west to east: the belvedere, the walled garden and the lime walk in one row.
The region north to south: the conservatory and potting room against the garden's north wall, the garden, and open grass to the south.
From y 54, under the stove cellar, to y 86, over the tallest tree crown.
The walled garden's lawn and paths west to east, inside its brick walls.
The walled garden north to south, inside its brick walls. The reflecting pool, 18 by 5, lies on its long axis.
The conservatory's glass front, west to east, against the north wall.
Glass walls to the eaves; the lean-to glass roof rises 4 more to the wall top.
The walk plane of the lime walk, the garden, the conservatory and the potting room.
The terrace on the west wall, five steps above the garden.
The stove cellar under the potting room, five steps below grade.
